draft.subject: Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatch for Vertex Retail (Jaipur to Ludhiana)
draft.body:
Subject: Update: Replacement Vehicle Dispatch for Vertex Retail (Jaipur to Ludhiana)

Dear Vertex Retail Team,

Following a breakdown of vehicle RJ66RW8007, a replacement unit (RJ58AM5345) has been dispatched from our Jaipur hub to complete the Jaipur to Ludhiana route.

Due to the delay, the estimated arrival is after today's 18:00 gate close. Per our standing arrangement, the vehicle will be held at the last halt and delivered with the morning gate at 08:00.

This will be recorded as a scheduled morning delivery, not a failed attempt.

Regards,
Meridian Freight Dispatch
